scope: reproducible forensic audit signals; no causal claims
limitations: Timezone field semantics are undocumented; timezone audit is sensitivity analysis, not a correction.
Vendor disposition mapping effective dates and approved crosswalk are absent.
Identity conflicts require HR/vendor master-data adjudication.
Historical month-opening eligible balance and eligibility rules are absent, so true recovery rate and denominator manipulation cannot be conclusively tested.
No randomized assignment or holdout exists; targeting/campaign effects remain descriptive.
Attribution-window sensitivity is not causal attribution because payment may be unrelated to treatment and exposures overlap.
